user.title: EG.D low tariff (HDO)
user.description: Times come from the public EG.D API. No account is needed.

data_description.psc: Only for an HDO receiver. Used once to find your region and not stored.

region.title: Region
region.description: Your postal code belongs to more than one EG.D region. If you are not sure, try one and compare the HDO codes with the label on your receiver.

tariff.title: Tariff
tariff.description: The distribution tariff is on your electricity bill, e.g. D25d. TAR is the main tariff relay, TUV switches water heating.

code.title: HDO code
code.description: The code is on the label of the HDO receiver in the meter box, on the smart meter display, or in the Distribuce24 app. Each option shows today's low-tariff times.

error.invalid_psc: Enter a postal code with 5 digits.
error.unknown_psc: EG.D has no HDO region for this postal code.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the EG.D API. Try again later.
error.bad_data: The EG.D API sent data this integration cannot read.

abort.already_configured: This HDO schedule is already set up.
abort.bad_data: The EG.D API sent data this integration cannot read.

options.receiver: HDO receiver in the meter box
